contract.weights: 0 < w_i <= 1 and predictable before current Y_i
contract.streaming_structure: binary-counter immutable sorted runs; equal-sized runs merge on append
contract.claim_scope: same water-filling denominator as frozen batch solver, up to explicit floating-point and root/endpoint bisection tolerance

local_microbenchmark.environment: current research Python runtime; synthetic weights/scores; not production timing
local_microbenchmark.interpretation: The append-oriented structure already beats repeated full rebuilds in this synthetic n=2000 monitor at cadences 16/64/256. This does not imply the prototype is globally faster: a single isolated query after a long quiet period can still favor one batch rebuild, and Python object overhead/memory are not optimized.

complexity_accounting.append: Each observation participates in at most one merge per binary level, giving O(log n) amortized merge participation per observation for each lambda component.
complexity_accounting.suffix_stats_query: O(log n) live runs, each queried by binary search; O(log^2 n) comparison work per hinge-stat query before fixed numerical-iteration factors.
complexity_accounting.endpoint: Fixed outer endpoint bisection times fixed water-filling root bisection times the live-run suffix query. The current prototype favors update amortization over minimum single-query latency.
complexity_accounting.memory: Research prototype stores immutable run payloads plus suffix aggregates and therefore is not memory-minimal. Productionization should compact per-item payload representation before deployment.

public_data_structure_alignment.source: O'Neil, Cheng, Gawlick, O'Neil, The Log-Structured Merge-Tree, Acta Informatica 1996
public_data_structure_alignment.use: Only the immutable sorted-run plus geometric merge architecture is borrowed as a data-structure pattern; statistical validity comes from the existing role-local water-filling/e-process derivation, not from LSM literature.

measurement_validity_guards: Do not call the incremental implementation statistically stronger than the batch reference; it is a computational refactoring under the same contract.
Do not infer production speedup from the local Python microbenchmark.
Do not use outcome-dependent current weights or realized process sizes as predictable weights.
Root/endpoint iteration tolerances are part of numerical implementation validation and must fail closed if the water-filling residual exceeds tolerance.
